## Core Products & Software

- [FlowRupee](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/flowrupee): 100% offline, privacy-first automated personal finance & SMS expense tracker app for India. Published on Google Play Store. Zero bank logins, zero cloud storage.
- [StatusGrid](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/statusgrid): High-performance festival greeting and poster creator PWA for Indian festivals (Diwali, Gudi Padwa, Shiv Jayanti) in Marathi, Hindi & English with custom photos, branding, and 1-tap WhatsApp sharing.
- [LeadPluck](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/leadpluck/bpahfdopbilojjdbkhafojahdmagdbdd): Local-first Google Maps and business website lead extractor Chrome extension available on the Chrome Web Store. Automates contact collection without cloud servers. Landing page: https://utkarshkarale.github.io/leadpluck.
- [WebStickly](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/webstickly): Web annotation and pinned note extension with spotlight search, collaborative public note walls, and persistent URL anchors.
- [CleanUpload](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/cleanupload): 100% client-side privacy tool to strip EXIF, GPS coordinates, and generative AI provenance metadata from images before publishing.
- [Monitoro](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/monitoro): Telegram-based uptime monitoring service providing real-time website and server incident alerts.
- [Daymark](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/daymark): Minimal daily progress tracking and habit reflection workspace.
- [SuddhaInbox](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/shuddhainbox): Automated inbox cleaner designed to purge promotional clutter and reach Inbox Zero.
- [Cartext AI](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/cartext-ai): Desktop voice and natural-language assistant automating local file management and OS workflows using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- [Bit QR](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/projects/bitqr): Instant QR code generator utility for digital URLs and Wi-Fi credentials.

## Technical Skills & Stack

- **Frontend & Web:** Astro, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, HTML5 Canvas, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Vite.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Flask), RESTful APIs, Webhooks, Telegram Bot APIs.
- **AI & Automation:** Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM prompt engineering, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), DeepFace emotion recognition, NLP speech assistants, automated browser scraping.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare D1, Cloudflare Workers & Tunnels, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Git.

## Key Articles & Guides

- [Automatic Expense Tracking via SMS in India: Architecture & Privacy](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/blog/automatic-expense-tracking-sms-india): In-depth guide on regex parsing Indian bank SMS messages completely on-device without cloud data leakage.
- [Why Personal Finance Tracking Fails in India](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/blog/why-personal-finance-tracking-fails-in-india-flowrupee): Analysis of account aggregator friction and why offline local-first models win.
- [Building StatusGrid with Web Technologies for Indian Festival Posters](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/blog/building-statusgrid-web-technologies-for-festival-posters): High-resolution HTML5 canvas rendering, Devanagari typography, and client-side animated video generation.
- [Understanding AI Image Metadata & Cleaning EXIF](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/blog/understanding-ai-image-metadata): Deep dive into C2PA, Stable Diffusion generation prompts, ExifTool, and privacy vectors.
- [Exposing Local Services Securely with Cloudflare Tunnels](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/blog/ssh-cloudflare-tunnel): Guide to zero-trust SSH access without port forwarding.
- [WebStickly Launch & Browser Automations](https://utkarshkarale.github.io/blog/webstickly-launch-and-automations): Architecture of persistent web page sticky notes and DOM coordinate recalculations.
